messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High p50/p95 latency observed for model family 'taurus-13b' (region: us-west-2). Error rate up 6% in last 5m. Auto-suppression not triggered. @sre-oncall
alex: I see the spike, p95 is ~1.2s for taurus-13b compared to baseline 400ms. Other families normal. Likely request amplification from a few heavy customers.
alex: Proposing targeted per-family RPM/TPM reduction for taurus-13b to buy breathing room. Will keep generation-quality flags on.
mira: Agreed. Set taurus-13b RPM -> 80 (was 250), TPM -> 600 (was 1500). Also increase taurus-7b RPM -> 400 to offload safe traffic where possible.
zhou: Ready to apply. Command in ops-runbook:
```
# run from ops bastion
rwctl rate update --model taurus-13b --rpm 80 --tpm 600 --reason "live latency mitigation"
rwctl rate update --model taurus-7b --rpm 400 --tpm 2000 --reason "spillover routing"
```
alex: Applying now, will monitor traces and token throughput. I'll keep the console open for 10m.
deploy-bot: rate-change: change-request accepted by policy-check. Job id: rc-20260315-42
zhou: Change applied at 1999991298. Service logs show throttling counters incrementing, new quota enforced.
veronica: Support team notified via #support-alerts with suggested customer messaging: "We’ve applied short-term traffic controls to one model family to reduce latency; no data loss expected."
support-bot: Message posted to customers flagged as affected (internal ticket #INC-4128).
alex: Observing p95 drop from 1.2s -> 420ms within 90s, error rate down to baseline. Good.
mira: Nice. Can you pin the exact flux windows and affected customers to the incident card? We should follow up with per-customer rate audit.
alex: Will attach traces and top-k callers in the incident doc. Plan: keep the quota delta for 30m, then do gradual rollback if stable.
zhou: Handing to mira for 2h watch. If p95 creeps above 700ms -> rollback rpm/tpm to previous and notify @oncall-rotation.
mira: Taking over. I'll create a follow-up action list: 1) post-mortem, 2) recommend permanent soft-limits for heavy callers, 3) consider prefix-caching for common prompts.
veronica: Support will prepare proactive outreach for customers whose calls were rate-limited; include mitigation steps and ETA for normal service.
alex: Adding to incident timeline and tagging related telemetry alerts. Closing caller-facing note in 30m unless regress.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied -> monitoring. Owner: mira. Followup: postmortem required if impact > 15m or if customer-facing errors > 5 customers.
